children: FrontView REIT amended the employment agreements of Stephen Preston, Pierre Revol and Drew Ireland to revise how the bonus component of cash severance is calculated.

For a Qualifying Termination, the bonus component of cash severance is based on the same multiple of the greater of the prior two-year average annual bonus or the target annual bonus opportunity for the termination year.
